headline: Quality Power Electrical Equipments issues corrigendum for EGM notice
hook: Notice correction ahead of October EGM
summary: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Limited has issued a corrigendum to the notice of its upcoming Extra Ordinary General Meeting scheduled for October 19, 2026. The filing was submitted to the stock exchange for official record updates. Such corrections are routine procedural updates prior to shareholder meetings. Retail investors holding the stock should note the updated meeting documentation.
whats_next: Extra Ordinary General Meeting on October 19, 2026
why_it_matters: Routine procedural filing with no immediate financial impact.

headline: Quality Power Electrical Equipments submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: Procedural compliance filing from Quality Power
summary: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results from its Annual General Meeting held on September 29, 2026, to the stock exchange. This is a routine post-AGM compliance filing required for listed entities. No shareholder actions or business decisions were highlighted in the filing notice. Indian retail investors holding this micro-cap stock experience no direct financial impact from this procedural disclosure.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with zero immediate financial impact.
